title: iPSC Freezing Protocol
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8zfrx6
materials: Tap dish to aid in dislocation of cells.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Gently wash cells with 1× PBS using 2–3 mL per well of a 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Add Accutase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add Accutase (Gibco A11105‑01) directly to the cells (0.75–1 mL per well of a 6‑well plate or 3 mL per 10 cm² dish) and incubate at 37 °C for 3–4 minutes, monitoring until single‑cell dissociation is achieved.

steps.title: Add DMEM/F12 and scrape if needed
steps.instruction: Add DMEM/F12 directly to the cells (2–4 mL per well of a 6‑well plate or 9 mL per 10 cm² dish). If cells remain attached, gently dislodge them with a cell scraper applying 1–2 passes.

steps.title: Collect cells into conical tube
steps.instruction: Collect the cell suspension into an appropriate conical tube (15 mL or 50 mL depending on total volume).

steps.title: Rinse dish and add to tube
steps.instruction: Add an additional 2–5 mL DMEM/F12 to the dish to rinse any remaining cells, then transfer this rinse to the same conical tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 750 rpm for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the supernatant, leaving 0.5–1 mL of media to avoid disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in mTesR1
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in mTesR1 (no ROCK inhibitor) using a volume equal to half of the final freezing volume (e.g., for 10 cryovials, add 5 mL mTesR1 to the pellet). Pipet the suspension 1–2 times only to preserve clumps.

steps.title: Add cold 2x freezing media
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of cold 2× freezing media (20 % DMSO in FBS) to the mTesR1 suspension, pipetting once only to maintain clumps.

steps.title: Aliquot into labeled cryovials
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of the cell suspension into each pre‑labeled cryovial, labeling each with cell type, line name, passage number, date, and your name.

steps.title: Freeze vials at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Place the cryovials in foam racks and freeze at –80 °C for 48–72 hours (minimum 48 hours).

steps.title: Transfer to liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: After the initial freeze, transfer the cryovials to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.
